first_collection.premise: A didactic time-travel journey through the global history of sound, written from the perspective of contemporary music obsessives transported into each era.

narrative_contract.perspective: Human-centered time-travel listener: we inhabit an early-human sound world with present/future critical questions while keeping immersive reconstruction distinct from evidence.
narrative_contract.rule: The modern/future analytical consciousness belongs to the narrator. It must never be projected onto prehistoric people as fact.

first_volume.academic_title: O Primeiro Ouvinte — Som, consciência e experiência humana antes da música organizada
first_volume.scope: A human-centered study of listening, environmental sound, body, voice, echo, objects, pattern, memory and social sound before formal musical systems become archaeologically visible.
first_volume.perspective: A controlled time-travel thought experiment: a present/future critical consciousness experiences early-human material and sensory conditions without importing modern technology or claiming access to prehistoric minds.
first_volume.thesis: The deep history of music begins with the human act of listening, not with the first surviving instrument.
excludes_as_primary_scope: pre-human evolutionary history of acoustic communication

narrative_protocol.name: BITEMPORAL_LENS
narrative_protocol.definition: Evidence-bound immersion: the reader inhabits a historically constrained human scene while a separated present/future analytical lens interrogates the evidence.
narrative_protocol.historical_minds_rule: Modern/future analytical consciousness belongs to the narrator and is never projected onto prehistoric people as fact.
